payload.claim: record_policy's docstring calls this "PACKAGE's own write-back", but this diff adds a second caller: saffron/cell/session.py's _drive_cell now calls ledger.record_policy(task_id, policy_sha) at cell start whenever a given task's recorded policy_sha differs (session.py:1773-1774). The same is true of task_policy_sha's docstring at ledger.py:1262-1266, which says "PACKAGE reads this back to decide whether a re-verification ran under a different declaration" — session.py now reads and writes it before PACKAGE ever runs. Neither docstring was updated, so a reader trusting either claim will misdiagnose where a task's policy_sha changed.
